Exact v1 file identity, dates and checksum if access is granted

Native flood detection support is about 250 m; a 30 m storage grid does not create independent 30 m information.

Download a chosen event ZIP; retain README, LICENSE and properties JSON.
Confirm the actual event footprint and commercial-use permission before consultancy use.

verification.label: Version-pinned collection and all 2,140 CMR filenames checked. Protected NetCDF variables have not been independently retrieved.

noaa_atlas14_precip_frequency.summary: Select a point in PFDS, confirm its volume, then choose depth, units, duration and series. Download the estimate and confidence tables.

era5_single_level_water_balance.summary: Choose total precipitation, runoff and snow depth in the CDS hourly form. Set dates, area and output format.
era5_single_level_water_balance.auth: A CDS account and acceptance of the dataset terms are required for download.
era5_single_level_water_balance.spatialDelivery: Atmospheric model near 31 km, distributed on a regular 0.25° CDS grid.
era5_single_level_water_balance.temporalDelivery: Hourly output. In the hourly high-resolution stream, precipitation and runoff accumulate over the preceding hour. SWE is an instantaneous state.

verification.label: Provider documentation and access route reviewed.

notes: Precipitation and runoff are modeled grid amounts; distinguish hourly high-resolution fields from ensemble or monthly statistics.
steps: Choose total precipitation, runoff and snow depth in the CDS hourly form. Set dates, area and output format.
Examine historical water balance and seasonal snow storage after aligning grid cells, accumulation windows and units.

era5_land_water_balance.summary: Choose total precipitation, runoff and snow depth in the CDS hourly form. Set dates, area and output format.
era5_land_water_balance.auth: A CDS account and acceptance of the dataset terms are required for download.
era5_land_water_balance.spatialDelivery: Native land model near 9 km, distributed on a 0.1° CDS grid.
era5_land_water_balance.temporalDelivery: Hourly output. Precipitation and runoff in the hourly CDS archive accumulate from the start of the 00 UTC forecast. Difference successive steps within a forecast, preserving the midnight 24-hour total. SWE is an instantaneous state.

verification.label: Provider documentation and access route reviewed.

notes: The forecast reset changes the differencing rule at midnight; retain the forecast steps.
steps: Choose total precipitation, runoff and snow depth in the CDS hourly form. Set dates, area and output format.
Examine historical water balance and seasonal snow storage after aligning grid cells, accumulation windows and units.

prism_conus_daily_ppt.spatialDelivery: 4 km CONUS grid. Local terrain and station coverage affect representativeness.
prism_conus_daily_ppt.temporalDelivery: Daily total for the 24 hours ending at 12 UTC on the labeled day. Compare station observation-day boundaries.

verification.label: Provider documentation and access route reviewed.

notes: Station density, terrain and changing input networks affect local estimates and trends.

daymet_v4r1_daily_prcp.summary: Find yearly precipitation granules for the regional grid. Extract prcp and preserve the Daymet calendar.
daymet_v4r1_daily_prcp.auth: Public metadata. Earthdata Login is required for protected files.
daymet_v4r1_daily_prcp.spatialDelivery: 1 km Lambert conformal conic grids for continental North America, Hawaii and Puerto Rico. The regional files are distinct.
daymet_v4r1_daily_prcp.temporalDelivery: 365 daily values per year. Leap years include February 29 and omit December 31.

verification.label: Exact collection and a provider granule link checked; protected data values unverified.

notes: Leap-year December 31 is absent. Align calendars before comparing annual totals or daily events.
steps: Find yearly precipitation granules for the regional grid. Extract prcp and preserve the Daymet calendar.
Estimate daily precipitation for a project area with the appropriate regional grid, projected coordinates and calendar.

gridmet_daily_precipitation.summary: Choose the pr_YYYY.nc precipitation file for each requested year. Read its coordinates, units, time axis and fill value.
gridmet_daily_precipitation.spatialDelivery: 1/24° CONUS grid, approximately 4 km. Effective spatial detail depends on the source fields.
gridmet_daily_precipitation.temporalDelivery: Daily accumulations. The precipitation day follows the source observing convention; align with gauge observation windows.

verification.label: Provider documentation and access route reviewed.

notes: Terrain-scale precipitation gradients and extremes can be smoothed; verify time support and provisional updates.
steps: Choose the pr_YYYY.nc precipitation file for each requested year. Read its coordinates, units, time axis and fill value.
Assess daily rainfall and antecedent moisture inputs alongside other gridMET meteorological variables.

nldas2_hourly_forcing_precip.summary: Find hourly File A granules and select total precipitation. Read per-file field names, units and temporal bounds.
nldas2_hourly_forcing_precip.auth: Public metadata. Earthdata Login is required for protected files.
nldas2_hourly_forcing_precip.spatialDelivery: 1/8° grid over central North America, approximately 12–14 km. This record selects precipitation in File A.
nldas2_hourly_forcing_precip.temporalDelivery: One-hour precipitation accumulation. Read interval time coordinates before daily aggregation.

verification.label: Exact collection and a provider granule link checked; protected data values unverified.

notes: Temporal disaggregation depends on available radar, satellite and other inputs. Methods change across regions and eras.
steps: Find hourly File A granules and select total precipitation. Read per-file field names, units and temporal bounds.
Prepare historical hydrological model precipitation forcing with explicit hourly totals and grid support.

usdm_weekly_drought.summary: Choose a Tuesday in the merged GIS archive. Intersect the CONUS polygons with the project in an equal-area projection, assigning the highest class at each location to calculate exclusive areas.
usdm_weekly_drought.spatialDelivery: Regional drought-class polygons. A polygon can cross many watersheds and contains no within-class intensity measurement.
usdm_weekly_drought.temporalDelivery: Weekly map valid Tuesday and normally released Thursday. Compare editions by their valid date.

verification.label: Provider documentation and access route reviewed.

notes: Use mutually exclusive polygons for class areas. Overlapping threshold files must not be summed across classes.
steps: Choose a Tuesday in the merged GIS archive. Intersect the CONUS polygons with the project in an equal-area projection, assigning the highest class at each location to calculate exclusive areas.
Report the fraction of a project area in each mutually exclusive weekly drought class.

smap_l4_surface_rootzone_moisture.summary: Find exact-version granules, then choose surface or root-zone soil moisture and the corresponding quality information.
smap_l4_surface_rootzone_moisture.auth: Public metadata. Earthdata Login is required for protected files.
smap_l4_surface_rootzone_moisture.spatialDelivery: 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 estimates over land. Root-zone water is a modeled state informed indirectly by the observations.
smap_l4_surface_rootzone_moisture.temporalDelivery: Three-hourly geophysical fields. Inspect the model time bounds and analysis quality.

verification.label: Exact collection and a provider granule link checked; protected data values unverified.

modis_mod16a2gf_actual_et.summary: Find 061 granules intersecting the project dates and area. Select the ET field and QA, apply scale after masking, then sum valid composite depths.
modis_mod16a2gf_actual_et.auth: Public metadata. Earthdata Login is required for protected files.
modis_mod16a2gf_actual_et.spatialDelivery: 500 m MODIS sinusoidal land tiles. Tile overlap does not establish a valid vegetated pixel.
modis_mod16a2gf_actual_et.temporalDelivery: 8-day ET sums. The final composite in a year covers 5 or 6 days; use its actual length when converting to a mean rate.

verification.label: Exact collection and a provider granule link checked; protected data values unverified.

notes: ET and PET have different meanings. Apply QA, scale and fill rules separately to ET; year-end gap filling introduces latency.
steps: Find 061 granules intersecting the project dates and area. Select the ET field and QA, apply scale after masking, then sum valid composite depths.

usgs_groundwater_discrete_levels.spatialDelivery: Individual monitoring well and screened aquifer interval. Nearby wells may represent different aquifers.
usgs_groundwater_discrete_levels.temporalDelivery: Irregular individual visits with time, quality/approval and well condition qualifiers.

verification.label: Provider documentation and access route reviewed.

notes: Depth below local land surface cannot be subtracted across wells to infer a hydraulic gradient without surveyed elevations and consistent datums.
steps: Filter field measurements to parameter 72019, a monitoring location or bounding box, and project dates. Follow pagination and retain depth reference, approval and qualifiers.
